arabic text: Parda duniya ko sikhane wali aayi bazaaron mein Zainab
english translation text: Zainab, who taught the world the meaning of modesty, was brought through the marketplaces

arabic text: Ghar se Bahar bhi na aane wali aayi bazaaron mein Zainab\nParda duniya ko sikhane wali aayi bazaaron mein Zainab
english translation text: She who would not even leave her home was brought through the marketplaces\nZainab, who taught the world the meaning of modesty, was brought through the marketplaces

arabic text: Jisne baba se chura-e-the kahi baar aseer Qaidi azaad karane wali aayi bazaaron\nmein Zainab\nParda duniya ko sikhane wali aayi bazaaron mein Zainab
english translation text: She who had often freed captives through her father She who set prisoners free was brought through\nZainab in the marketplaces\nZainab, who taught the world the meaning of modesty, was brought through the marketplaces

arabic text: Jalte Khaimon se utha layi abbas ke bad Ali aabid ko bachane wali aayi\nbazaaron mein Zainab\nParda duniya ko sikhane wali aayi bazaaron mein Zainab
english translation text: After Abbas, she carried Abid from the burning tents She who saved Ali Abid was brought\nZainab in the marketplaces\nZainab, who taught the world the meaning of modesty, was brought through the marketplaces

arabic text: Deen ki khaatir ye bibi saalar bani banke abbas dikhane wali aayi bazaaron\nmein Zainab\nParda duniya ko sikhane wali aayi bazaaron mein Zainab
english translation text: For the sake of faith, this lady became the commander She who became an Abbas was brought through\nZainab in the marketplaces\nZainab, who taught the world the meaning of modesty, was brought through the marketplaces

arabic text: Apne seenay pe sakina ko zindanon mein baad bhayi ke sulaane wali aayi\nbazaaron mein Zainab\nParda duniya ko sikhane wali aayi bazaaron mein Zainab
english translation text: In the prisons she laid Sakina upon her chest She who put her to sleep after her brother was brought\nZainab in the marketplaces\nZainab, who taught the world the meaning of modesty, was brought through the marketplaces

arabic text: Nange sar parti rahi khutbe bazaaron mein Kasre dushman ko hilane wali aayi\nbazaaron mein Zainab\nParda duniya ko sikhane wali aayi bazaaron mein Zainab
english translation text: Bareheaded, she delivered sermons in the marketplaces She who shook the enemy's palace was brought\nZainab in the marketplaces\nZainab, who taught the world the meaning of modesty, was brought through the marketplaces

arabic text: Kufe aur shaam bhi sare gaye ye baali johar Azmate deen ko barhane wali aayi\nbazaaron mein Zainab\nParda duniya ko sikhane wali aayi bazaaron mein Zainab
english translation text: Kufa and Shaam witnessed this precious lady, "Johar" She who raised the honour of the faith was brought\nZainab in the marketplaces\nZainab, who taught the world the meaning of modesty, was brought through the marketplaces
